changelog: JellyTrack Plugin v2.0.0.1: Security hardening and stability release. SSRF protection against cloud metadata endpoints, HTTP redirect token leakage prevention, bounded response reading and in-memory caches, configuration UI hardening against prototype pollution and ReDoS.
description: JellyTrack is an analytics dashboard for Jellyfin. This plugin intercepts playback events, library changes and sends a periodic heartbeat to the JellyTrack server.
name: JellyTrack
overview: Jellyfin plugin to push playback events to JellyTrack
